sample.key: SHA256(UTF8(9184 + LF + catalog_sha256 + LF + family + LF + condition + '/' + view)) first 16 bytes as unsigned big-endian integer, NumPy PCG64, uniform without replacement, C-order indices stored sorted
sample.applies_to: same row identities for all learned models

preprocessing: Numeric finite unweighted training-sample median; zero only for an everywhere-missing column. Family/condition/view-equal weighted mean and population standard deviation after imputation. Exactly constant or zero-variance column uses scale 1. Keep missing and empty flags as 0/1. Each CV fold learns its own transform.

light.loss: binary cross entropy, L2 penalty, unpenalized intercept, lbfgs, no class weights
light.folds: Sorted training family IDs, ordinal modulo 4, grouped across all views and both reconstructions. If any training complement lacks either class or fold is empty, repeat modulo 3 then 2. No supported fold or no defined AP = record not fit.
light.cv_selection: Grouped original-score ties; AP only in two-class validation cell; average defined views inside condition, then defined conditions inside family, then defined held-out families across all folds. Within 1e-6 of maximum choose smallest C.

eligibility: A declared failed reconstruction or target contributes known reference V, E=0 and no score; invalid RGB and absent scores carry independent counts. A finite score with no matching reference RGB does not enter risk metrics.
visibility: For an allowed scorer source set, observed if any observed, else disoccluded if any disoccluded, else outside if any outside, else invalid/background. Also retain each original oracle code. Reconstruction geometry uses the generator's full set.
threshold: For each new method one all-source development threshold nearest to 0.80 L/V, never split score ties and prefer lower coverage on equal distance. Pool all six views in a family/condition for operating counts, weight the positive-V conditions equally per family and eligible families equally. The fixed B transfer uses the published original threshold.
selection_domain: Dev all-source E, finite transferred B-L1 score and deployable MS features scoreable. Both neural and light outputs must yield finite values on their declared scoreability; report any per-method support loss.
heldout: Require verified el-stage3-test-opening-1 via evidence_lens.stage3_gate before any test reference, reconstruction, dataset or score is consumed.
